attr.title: God of Thunder
attr.desc: Play Thor in three episodes of top-down action and puzzles. Throw your returning hammer, collect magical items, and challenge Loki's allies in a native source port.
attr.inst: Manually download https://www.adeptsoftware.com/got/gotfree.zip and extract all its contents into ports/godofthunder/gamedata. GOTRES.DAT and GOT.EXE must be directly inside gamedata. The port does not download assets. L2 switches Settings tabs, X saves, and Start cancels. Display > Stretch fills widescreen displays. R2 toggles fullscreen; Start+Select exits.
